text:
Ravi (Marketplace): Heads-up: Keystone Systems asked for a co-list private-offer for their Atlas appliance on AWS/GCP marketplaces. They want a gating commit + temporary SKU exclusivity. Need input on offer economics and renewal language.
Nina (Partnerships): What's their minimum commit and requested discount? Also any co-marketing money or launch support ask?
Ravi (Marketplace): They propose $250k ARR commit to enable the listing, with a 20% off list for 12 months. They also requested a 6-week exclusivity on that private SKU and $30k co-marketing contribution.
Diego - HW Alliances: 6 weeks exclusive SKU is doable, but we should ask for a performance milestone (e.g., 3 marketplace transactions or 20 leads) to justify exclusivity. Otherwise it's just gating.
Tess (Legal): For exclusivity, we prefer a defined carve-out and termination for low-activity. Also auto-renew is sensitive; propose opt-in renewal unless customer explicitly signs a renewal.
Ravi (Marketplace): Can we do a tiered offer instead? $250k/12mo @20% or $375k/18mo @25%. Add a marketplace-onboard credit of $15k if they hit first-month transactions.
Nina (Partnerships): Sounds sensible. Add a "consumption collar": if usage >120% of commit across a 90-day window, we renegotiate price or convert to reserved pricing for next term. Keeps economics safe.
Diego - HW Alliances: Agreed. Also request SKU mapping: Atlas-ENT-PRV should map to our standard Atlas-ENT SKU so usage/meters align. Ops: any blocker with meter mapping?
infra-bot: Meter mapping requires a private SKU entry + billing alias. Estimated work: 3 business days after signed agreement. No infra blockers otherwise.
Tess (Legal): For renewal stance: we can do auto-renew but must include 90/60/30 day notification and allow written opt-out 30 days before renewal. Also include audit rights for usage measurement and an escalation path for disputes.
Ravi (Marketplace): Good. On co-marketing: Keystone wants a joint announcement on day-of-listing and a webinar 30 days post-launch. Do we accept their ask for a co-funded paid campaign?
Nina (Partnerships): We can commit to the announcement + one webinar. For paid campaigns, ask for a co-fund request and a creative brief; Partnerships can approve up to $25k from the co-marketing pool. Anything above needs GTM director sign-off.
Diego - HW Alliances: I'll push Keystone to accept the milestone for exclusivity and confirm delivery logistics for appliances. Need ETA on shipping timeline to ensure listing meets the public announcement date.
Tess (Legal): Also include a data handling addendum specifying that marketplace procurement data remains with Redwood for billing and analytics. Keystone must agree to not list conflicting SKUs in our marketplace during exclusivity.
Ravi (Marketplace): Next steps: I'll draft a 1-pager term sheet with the two tiers, exclusivity milestone, consumption collar, renewal notification, and co-marketing limits. Can someone own direct negotiation with Keystone?
Nina (Partnerships): I'll lead negotiations and loop in GTM for any ask >$25k.
Diego - HW Alliances: I'll get the shipping SLA and appliance delivery dates.
Tess (Legal): I'll prepare a short legal playbook segment for exclusivity, renewal opt-out windows, audit language, and a short template addendum for co-marketing.
infra-bot: Calendar: sync scheduled 11:00 PT. Reminder will post 15 minutes before.
Ravi (Marketplace): Thanks team. Ill drop the draft term sheet in the drive and tag you. If all good, we'll present to Keystone tomorrow afternoon. :rocket:
